query:
SELECT count(*) AS "count!" FROM (
               SELECT 1 FROM activity AS e
               WHERE e.workspace_id = $1 AND e.created_at >= $5
                 AND (e.area = ANY($2::text[])
                      OR (e.project_id, e.area) IN (SELECT * FROM unnest($3::uuid[], $4::text[])))
               LIMIT $6) AS capped
